environment.display: none; framebuffer captures through loopback-only QMP

source_references: Compiler/Lex.HC:Lex, KW_ELSE, lex_else, KW_IFAOT, KW_IFJIT, KW_ENDIF

input_delivery.mechanism: QMP input-send-event with explicit key/modifier down events and reverse-order key/modifier up events
input_delivery.preflight: The prior arithmetic/punctuation preflight printed PREFLIGHT=5 and the explicit-release member preflight printed KEY_RELEASE last=0 err=0 warn=0 line=1.
input_delivery.discarded_attempts: Earlier helper definitions sent with QMP send-key hold-time overlapped Shift across underscore boundaries and visibly changed member-name case. They are input-delivery failures and are not compatibility evidence.

helper_command:
U0 O27D(U8 *l,U8 *s){CCmpCtrl *c=CmpCtrlNew(StrNew(s));I64 t,n=0;while ((t=Lex(c))!=TK_EOF && n<8){n++;if (t==TK_IDENT)"%s T%d=%X:%s last=%d line=%d err=%d warn=%d
",l,n,t,c->cur_str,c->last_line_num,c->lex_include_stk->line_num,c->error_cnt,c->warning_cnt;else "%s T%d=%X last=%d line=%d err=%d warn=%d
",l,n,t,c->last_line_num,c->lex_include_stk->line_num,c->error_cnt,c->warning_cnt;}"%s EOF=%X last=%d line=%d err=%d warn=%d
",l,t,c->last_line_num,c->lex_include_stk->line_num,c->error_cnt,c->warning_cnt;CmpCtrlDel(c);}

position_fields.last: CCmpCtrl.last_line_num as observed after each Lex call; Lex assigns it from the current include-frame line at call entry.
position_fields.line: CCmpCtrl.lex_include_stk->line_num as observed when Lex returned.
position_fields.hosted_strict: One-based byte line and column of the diagnostic primary span in the original source.
position_fields.comparison: Native cursor fields include lookahead and are retained as observations. They are not equated with hosted token or diagnostic starts.

token_format: %X; TK_IDENT was observed as 0x100 and TK_EOF as 0x0.

pass_a: SE_A EOF=0 last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: SE_B EOF=0 last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0

pass_a: SI_A T1=100:value last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
SI_A EOF=0 last=3 line=3 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: SI_B T1=100:value last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
SI_B EOF=0 last=3 line=3 err=0 warn=0

pass_a: DE_A T1=100:one last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
DE_A T2=100:after last=7 line=9 err=0 warn=0
DE_A EOF=0 last=9 line=9 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: DE_B T1=100:one last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
DE_B T2=100:after last=7 line=9 err=0 warn=0
DE_B EOF=0 last=9 line=9 err=0 warn=0

pass_a: EU_A T1=100:value last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
EU_A EOF=0 last=3 line=3 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: EU_B T1=100:value last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
EU_B EOF=0 last=3 line=3 err=0 warn=0

pass_a: FE_A EOF=0 last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: FE_B EOF=0 last=1 line=3 err=0 warn=0

pass_a: SR_A T1=100:after last=3 line=5 err=0 warn=0
SR_A EOF=0 last=5 line=5 err=0 warn=0
pass_b: SR_B T1=100:after last=3 line=5 err=0 warn=0
SR_B EOF=0 last=5 line=5 err=0 warn=0

capture_retention: The ISO, raw PPM captures, accepted input files and input driver remain in local validation storage outside tracked repository files. The raw framebuffer hashes identify the reviewed evidence.
repeatability: Two runs in one isolated boot produced identical records after removing only the A/B label. This establishes repeatability in that environment.
hosted_projection: The test replays the captured source through the permissive preprocessor and compares original token kinds, spellings and error/warning counts. Strict token and diagnostic projections are separate hosted expectations.
